name: trace_android_references
description: Trace incoming static using nodes to an exact Android class or selected method overload. A method target may be an external class directly named by DEX invokes: target_definition external and reference_scope direct_dex_invokes identify this narrower inventory, without inventing a class definition or body. Ambiguous external requests list observed DEX prototypes; select overload_index explicitly. For APK-defined targets use inspect_android_class. The total counts containing nodes, not individual invokes. External callers include source_selector for inspect_android_method. Source lines and the containing node dex_offset remain unknown. direct_invokes carries exact DEX code-unit offsets when available; direct_invokes_exhaustive false marks byte-bounded partial instruction evidence, and null means unknown. No reflection, JNI or runtime dispatch is inferred.
